systems.name: bodesign MCP Server
systems.description: AI PCB design copilot delivered as a standalone MCP server

systems.name: SPICE Toolchain
systems.description: ngspice + spice skill scripts (host-side, unmodified): model resolution cascade, subcircuit simulation

containers.name: component-kb
containers.description: Vault L4 spec_values EAV + field_path registry + spice model card generation (new)

containers.name: eda-bridge
containers.description: Thin orchestration over kicad/spice skills; simulate_schematic

components.name: Field Path Registry
components.description: A1/DD-3: spice_model.{diode,ldo,passive}.* closed v1 roots; unknown path fails fast with nearby candidates; verified-needs-evidence trigger preserved

components.name: Extraction Ingester
components.description: A2/DD-4: per-row validation (registry + sha256/page evidence + numeric value); SPX_EVIDENCE_MISSING rejects rows; not_found reported, never written; trust=unverified

components.name: Model Card Generator
components.description: A3/DD-5: deterministic f-string templates (.model diode / .subckt ldo / .subckt passive); typ-selection rule; SPX_PARAMS_MISSING with repair guidance; byte-identical output with provenance header

components.name: Card Materializer
components.description: A4/DD-2,DD-7: ngspice DC-op smoke; pass/skipped -> write card + manifest entry (source=vault-grounded) into <project>/spice/models/; fail -> SPX_SMOKE_FAILED, card excluded

components.name: Simulation Annotator
components.description: A5/DD-8: deterministic manifest lookup marks each subcircuit result model_source=vault-grounded|generic-default

components.name: Evidence Adapter
components.description: A5/R5: wraps simulation results as ValidationEvidence(tool=spice) for spine return

components.name: Spice Card MCP Tool
components.description: DD-9: MCP surface — args {folder, mpn, category, materialize?}; returns ModelCard JSON; SPX_* error codes pass through run_tool wrapper

relationships.description: Resolves field_path per row (fail-fast on unknown)
Queries L4 spice_model.* rows; applies typ-selection
Hands rendered card for smoke + materialization
Project manifest (vault-grounded entries) consumed by cascade tier 1
Submits extraction batch (AI/skill-driven, evidence per row)
